title: Data of the event ext.monitor.account.v1
description: The E5 adapter's report of its own monitoring system account, read through the API with its own user (MON-4, OBS-11): the role rights wider than MON-4 allows, and the hosts the user sees and those where it may run a script, each as the SHA-256 of the host name, so no name of the monitoring system reaches the core. The adapter's signal carries visible and scripts; the core keeps them in its own table only and writes the event with findings, visible_count and scripts_count. The core compares the hashes with the catalog nodes of the tenants and the farm node list; doctor fails the account line of the tenant when the account is wider.

findings.description: Role rights wider than MON-4 allows: super_admin, the role actions acknowledge_problems, close_problems, suppress_problems, change_severity, edit_maintenance, the frontend sections alerts.actions and data_collection.maintenance, or role_unreadable.

visible.description: In the signal: every host the user sees, as sha256:<hex> of its host name.

scripts.description: In the signal: every visible host with a script the user may run, as sha256:<hex> of its host name.

visible_count.description: In the event: how many hosts the user sees; the hashes stay in the core's table.

scripts_count.description: In the event: how many visible hosts have a script the user may run.

truncated.description: The user sees more than 1000 hosts; visible holds the first 1000.
